schema.description: Settings schema version (>= 1; newer integral versions are preserved on save).

appearance.description: Application theme preference (Windows High Contrast overrides custom colors).

focusMode.description: Session-local distraction-free mode; ignored on load and omitted on save so restart never hides commands.

showOutline.description: Show the right-hand heading outline and inspector sidebar.

showFiles.description: Show the left-hand Markdown files pane.

filesRoot.description: Absolute Windows path to the pinned notebook folder root.

lastDocument.description: Absolute Windows path to the last normal active document to reopen on launch.

readingWidth.description: Maximum document reading width in DIPs.

dimInactiveBlocks.description: Dim inactive blocks while focus mode is active.

allowRemoteImages.description: Always allow anonymous http(s) remote image loading.

allowLocalNetworkImages.description: Allow image fetches from private, loopback, or same-share local network addresses when remote images are permitted.

imageFirstPaste.description: Prefer clipboard bitmap images over Unicode text when both are present.

strikeCompletedTasks.description: Apply strikethrough presentation to completed Markdown task items.

splitScrollSync.description: Link vertical scrolling between Compose and Source panes in Split view.

windowPlacement.description: Normal screen-coordinate window bounds, source DPI, and maximized state.

markdownSyntax.description: Optional RichMarkdown syntax extensions beyond GFM.
